title: Application of Commonwealth Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 98, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Power Cost Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of October, November, and December 1985. The Power Cost Charge reflects changes in pruedently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company. Application is also made by Commonwealth Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 106. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
